item.title: How Outsourcing Broke the Premium Promise at Europe’s Airlines
item.description: From 'boarding-not-boarding' to patchy priority rules, Europe’s premium airline experience is increasingly controlled by third parties – and it shows.

item.title: Warburg Pincus Invests in Lemon Tree’s Asset Arm as Hotel Group Splits in Two
item.description: Lemon Tree on Thursday denied Warburg buying into Lemon Tree, which was technically true. Two days later, it confirmed Warburg is indeed stepping into the group, just through a different door.

item.title: Google’s New Tech Lets AI Agents Handle Checkout
item.description: Google is laying new groundwork for AI-driven checkout. The underlying architecture can also handle more complex transactions, it says, putting travel squarely in its sights.

item.title: Allegiant to Acquire Sun Country Airlines for $1.5 Billion
item.description: Big news for a sleepy Sunday afternoon: Airline consolidation has been looming over 2026, but a merger between Allegiant and Sun Country underscores just how quickly that pressure is translating into action.

item.title: Why Lemon Tree’s Restructuring Matters Beyond One Hotel Chain in India
item.description: Indian hotels are clearly changing how they grow. Promoters are giving way to platforms, bricks are being separated from brands, and institutional money now wants clear roles of owner, operator, and capital - not everything bundled into one.

item.title: The Anti-Spirit Merger: Why Allegiant-Sun Country Makes Sense
item.description: Other low-cost carriers have attempted to outfly reality — adding capacity, chasing share, and hoping costs would normalize. Allegiant and Sun Country have done the opposite.

item.title: Aviation’s Climate Reckoning: Bill Gates and Airlines Sound Alarm
item.description: Aviation’s climate ambitions are hitting a political wall. Bill Gates and IATA warn that without global coordination, even the best technologies won’t deliver on decarbonization goals.

item.title: Overseas Travel to the U.S. Slumps for 8th Straight Month
item.description: The U.S. recovery in inbound travel is stalling, and policy, pricing, and perception are now compounding the problem.

item.title: Inside the Sun Country Merger: Allegiant CEO Explains the Deal
item.description: We've written a lot about the problems facing low-cost carriers. But both Allegiant and Sun Country stand out for finding a way to stay profitable.

item.title: ITC Hotels Ties Its Next Growth Phase to Delhi’s Expanding Convention District
item.description: While Delhi is very hotel-dense, the message through this land lease is clear: Bring convenient high-end accommodation right to the doorstep of event infrastructure for a suitable MICE ecosystem.
